title: Classic Sudoku Pro
description: Sharpen your logic across crisp 9x9 Sudoku grids with clean pencil notes, instant conflict checks, and multiple difficulty tiers from breezy to expert.
controls: Tap an empty cell and select digits 1–9 so every row, column, and 3x3 box contains each number once.

zh-CN.title: 经典数独
zh-CN.description: 全民脑力锻炼经典数独：清爽护眼 9x9 棋盘配智能笔记与多档难度，随时随地静心推理填满数字超解压！
zh-CN.controls: 点击空白格并选择 1 至 9 填入，确保每行、每列与每个九宫格数字均不重复。
